name: Harmony 650, two devices composed in one write
description: todo-compile-650 2.7, one write of lab/work/bench-2-7/h650-two-devices.bin: the Panasonic TX-29AK40F as 'Pana' and the Knoll HDP-1100 as 'Knoll', composed in one run onto the 650's own configuration (h650_panasonic_config), section 331. Neither is in any activity, so only their own pages send them. Start with nothing pressed since the write's restart, remote pointed at the Flirc. A side button is one of the buttons beside the screen, next to the corner whose label it chooses.

steps.instruction: The ordinary screen comes up, no request to sync. Press the centre button below the screen (Devices). Expect 'Devices 1/2': TV top left, KPN top right, Denon bottom left, PS3 bottom right. Nothing at the Flirc. Mark the step if the names or corners differ
Page on with the arrow. Expect 'Devices 2/2': Kodi top left, Panasonic TV top right, Pana bottom left, Knoll bottom right. These two new rows are the point of the run. Nothing at the Flirc

Press the side button beside Pana. Expect a page titled 'Pana' with one command, 'Power'. Press Power once, briefly. Expect at the Flirc the Panasonic power toggle as three frames, nothing else. (No television answers it here; the Flirc hearing it is the check)

Go back to the Devices list with the centre button, page on to 2/2 and press the side button beside Knoll. Expect a page titled 'Knoll' with one command, 'Power'. Press Power once, briefly. Expect the Knoll's power toggle, a 32 bit code, as about eight frames in one burst (its 'on' action, held 800 ms), nothing else
Press All Off. Expect nothing for Pana or Knoll: neither was switched on by an activity, so the remote thinks both are off. Anything the Flirc hears here, note it with the mark button
